name: The Riverbank
objective: Reach Clearfell

route.cue: Town is past the Miller

steps.detail: Pick up your weapon and skill gem, then follow the path inland.
Defeat the Miller to open the way into Clearfell Encampment.

name: Clearfell Encampment
objective: Speak with Renly and Una

name: Clearfell
objective: Find the path into the Grelwood

route.cue: Use the world map to find the exit side

steps.detail: Open the world map and check which side of Clearfell The Grelwood is on. Search that side of the zone for the exit.
Look for frozen logs around the Frostblood Ritual to find Beira and her permanent cold resistance reward.

optional.hint: Defeat Beira for cold resistance

reward.name: Cold resistance
reward.direction: Look for frozen logs around the Frostblood Ritual in Clearfell.

optional.hint: Defeat the Devourer for Finn

name: The Grelwood
objective: Investigate the Tree of Souls

route.cue: Glowing roots lead to the tree

steps.detail: Follow the roots to the Tree of Souls and activate the nearby waypoint.
Follow the river when you're looking for the Red Vale entrance.
After freeing the Hooded One and reporting back to Una, use the mushrooms to find the Grim Tangle entrance.

shortcut.cue: Tag the Grim Tangle waypoint early
shortcut.detail: If you reach the Grim Tangle entrance while exploring the Grelwood, step inside to activate its waypoint. After finishing Una’s turn-in in town, use that waypoint to resume the route.

optional.hint: Defeat the Brambleghast
Investigate the Starlit Rite and runic vault

name: The Red Vale
objective: Recover the girdles from the rust obelisks

route.cue: Sweep for three rust obelisks

steps.detail: Sweep around the zone for the three obelisks. Check the ground near the blood river if you still need one.
The last activation brings out the Rust King. Defeat him and collect the final quest piece.

shortcut.cue: Portal after collecting all three pieces
shortcut.detail: After defeating the Rust King and collecting all three obelisk quest items, open a portal to town. Get the Runed Spikes from Renly, then use the Grelwood waypoint to return to the Tree of Souls.

name: The Grim Tangle
objective: Cross to the Cemetery of the Eternals

route.cue: Past the roots, cross to the far edge

steps.detail: Call Una at the roots and pass through the opening.
Start by crossing the zone away from the entrance. Check the far edge for the cemetery exit.

shortcut.detail: Summon Una by the roots. Once the path is open, head through toward the cemetery while she finishes singing.

optional.hint: Defeat the Rotten Druid

name: Cemetery of the Eternals
objective: Recover both keys and confront Lachlann

route.cue: Sweep the edges for both tomb doors

steps.detail: Look for the Mausoleum of the Praetor and the Tomb of the Consort along the perimeter. You can clear them in either order.
After you have both key pieces, return to Lachlann to open the gate.

shortcut.detail: Locate and activate the checkpoints at both tomb entrances before clearing the tombs. Use the cemetery's checkpoint travel to get to the other entrance when you return with a key piece.

name: Mausoleum of the Praetor
objective: Defeat Draven and take his key piece

optional.hint: Open the Forgotten Riches trove

name: Tomb of the Consort
objective: Defeat Asinia and take her key piece

optional.hint: Search the Embattled Trove
Investigate the Hooded One’s request

name: Hunting Grounds
objective: Find the route to Ogham Farmlands

route.cue: Follow the signpost to the farmlands

steps.detail: Look around the edges for a signpost pointing toward Ogham Farmlands.
Follow the tracks through a narrow passage to find the Crowbell for passive points.

optional.hint: Defeat Crowbell for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from the Crowbell
reward.direction: Follow the bloody tracks in Hunting Grounds to the narrow entrance to the arena.

optional.hint: Take the side path to Freythorn

route.cue: Locusts point toward the next ritual

steps.detail: Watch where the locusts fly after a ritual and follow them toward another site.
After three rituals, activate the ritual in the boss arena to fight the King in the Mists.

optional.hint: Clear the rituals and defeat the King in the Mists for Spirit

reward.name: Spirit from the King in the Mists
reward.direction: In Freythorn, follow the locusts between ritual sites. Finish three rituals to open the boss encounter.

name: Ogham Farmlands
objective: Continue to Ogham Village

route.cue: Cross to the wall opposite the entrance

steps.detail: Go around the hut and the carts blocking the path to reach Una's hut and pick up her lute.
Cross away from the entrance. If the village door is out of sight, follow the far wall until you reach it.

shortcut.cue: Turn in the lute on your next town trip
shortcut.detail: Pick up Una’s lute on the way to Ogham Village. If you’re stopping in town for Renly’s tools, turn in the lute on the same visit.

optional.hint: Recover Una’s lute for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from Una’s lute
reward.direction: Look behind the long hut and carts in Ogham Farmlands, then bring the lute back to Una.

name: Ogham Village
objective: Defeat the Executioner and rescue Leitis
tip: Fire resistance helps against the Executioner. Move clear when he winds up for a heavy slam.

route.cue: Keep the wall on your right

steps.detail: From the entrance, keep the wall on your right and follow it north toward the Executioner's arena.
Look off the northern wall for a checkpoint beside the room with Renly's tools. If you reach the waypoint first, check back along the west side.

shortcut.cue: Portal to turn in Renly’s tools
shortcut.detail: If you pick up Renly’s Smithing Tools before the Executioner, portal to town to unlock the Salvage Bench. Make any vendor upgrades on the same trip, then use the portal to return to the village.

optional.hint: Recover Renly’s tools for the Salvage Bench

name: The Manor Ramparts
objective: Find a way into Ogham Manor

name: Ogham Manor
objective: Defeat Count Geonor
tip: Bring cold resistance for Geonor. Beira in Clearfell offers a permanent boost.

optional.hint: Defeat Candlemass for maximum life

reward.name: Maximum life from Candlemass
reward.direction: Find Candlemass in Ogham Manor and use the reward dropped by the fight.

name: Vastiri Outskirts
objective: Defeat Rathbreaker to earn passage

route.cue: Look for the narrow canyon

steps.detail: Start along the edge on the side the path leans as it leaves town. If it dead-ends, sweep the next outer edge.
Take the canyon into Rathbreaker's arena. Return to Zarka after the fight.

shortcut.detail: Once Rathbreaker is down, take a town portal and speak to Zarka to move on to the Ardura Caravan.

name: The Ardura Caravan
objective: Speak with Asala and use the Desert Map

shortcut.cue: For Ancient Vows, leave the Valley last
shortcut.detail: Once the three Horn of the Vastiri branches open, do the Keth and Bone Pits branches before the Valley of the Titans if you’re doing Ancient Vows. Bring both clan relics so you can use the altar on the same visit.

name: Traitor's Passage
objective: Take the passage to the Halani Gates

route.cue: Look for the Six Sisters bridge

steps.detail: Use the curved bridge as a marker and keep exploring away from the entrance toward the Halani Gates. The bridge can appear early.
At the Decree of Imprisonment junction, follow the marked walls to Balbala's prison for a Djinn Barya.

optional.hint: Defeat Balbala to unlock the Sekhemas trial

name: The Halani Gates
objective: Help Asala open the gates and pursue Jamanra

route.cue: Follow the bridges through the gates

steps.detail: Call Asala where the gates block the path. Continue over the bridges in the direction the passage opens.
Follow the bridges away from your entrance to reach Jamanra's arena.

optional.hint: Defeat L’im the Impaler

name: The Halani Gates
objective: Speak to Asala about the closed gates

name: The Halani Gates
objective: Investigate the sandstorm blocking the pursuit

name: Keth
objective: Find the entrance to the Lost City

route.cue: Sweep an edge toward the far corner

steps.detail: Follow either perimeter toward the far corner. Activate the Lost City entrance checkpoint when you find it.
Look for the Venom Pit checkpoint beside the round ruin to find Kabala. Fight serpent packs along the way if you still need the clan relic.

optional.hint: Defeat Kabala for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from Kabala
reward.direction: In Keth, look for the Venom Pit checkpoint beside a partly buried round building.

optional.hint: Look for the Kabala Clan Relic

name: The Lost City
objective: Find the Buried Shrines

route.cue: Cross the V-shaped bridge

steps.detail: Check the corners of the first section to find the bridge. After crossing, sweep the far wall for the wing-shaped approach to the Buried Shrines.
Kill Serpent Clan enemies as you pass if you still need the Kabala Clan Relic for Ancient Vows.

optional.hint: Look for the Kabala Clan Relic

name: Buried Shrines
objective: Defeat Azarian and recover the water essence
tip: Bring fire resistance for Azarian. The fire offering in the shrine gives you a Ruby Ring.

route.cue: Cross the bridges to the crown

steps.detail: Cross into the second section and look for a crown-shaped area on the minimap. It marks Azarian's approach.
A separate room has a checkpoint and lore marker. Choose the fire, water, or lightning offering for a ring of that element.

optional.hint: Claim an elemental resistance ring

name: Mastodon Badlands
objective: Find the entrance to the Bone Pits

route.cue: Follow an outer wall to the Bone Pits

steps.detail: Start by following the area boundary until you find the Bone Pits entrance.
Check the effigy beside its checkpoint if you want an extra uncut gem.

name: The Bone Pits
objective: Defeat Iktab and Ekbab for the tusks

route.cue: Cross the bone arch toward the far wall

steps.detail: Keep the direction you took through the starting arch. When you reach the far side, look along the wall for the arena opening.
Fight scavengers along the route if you need the Sun Clan Relic for Ancient Vows.

optional.hint: Look for the Sun Clan Relic

name: Valley of the Titans
objective: Open the Titan Grotto using the seals

route.cue: Check the perimeter and central gorge

steps.detail: Activate the checkpoint by the sealed door so you can return after finding all three Ancient Seals.
Look for seals by checkpoints around the edge. If one is missing, check the rim of the central gorge.
Place the Kabala and Sun Clan relics at the altar by the waypoint to finish Ancient Vows.

optional.hint: Use both clan relics at the altar

reward.name: Ancient Vows charm bonus
reward.direction: Bring the Kabala and Sun Clan relics to the altar by the Valley of the Titans waypoint.

name: The Titan Grotto
objective: Defeat Zalmarath and recover the Flame Ruby

route.cue: Find the long stair bridge

steps.detail: Use the direction of the starting corridor to orient through the winding rooms toward the far wall.
Look along that wall for the long, straight stairway leading to Zalmarath.

name: Deshar
objective: Find the Path of Mourning

route.cue: Cross the ruins to the far edge

steps.detail: Cross the open ground into the built-up section and search its far boundary for the Path of Mourning.
Check around the bases of the buildings for the body with the Final Letter. Bring the letter to Shambrin for passive points.

optional.hint: Retrieve the Final Letter for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from the Final Letter
reward.direction: Search ruined buildings in Deshar for the Fallen Dekhara. Take the letter to Shambrin.

name: Deshar
objective: Find the Path of Mourning

name: Path of Mourning
objective: Continue toward the Spires of Deshar

route.cue: Cross the bridges between towers

steps.detail: Take bridges that carry you farther across the zone. If a branch ends, return to the previous platform and try the next bridge.
Look for the exit to the Spires on the side opposite your entrance.

name: The Spires of Deshar
objective: Defeat Tor Gul

route.cue: Cross the spires to Tor Gul

steps.detail: Cross the connected platforms away from the entrance and activate Tor Gul's checkpoint near the far end.
Look for the shrine on a side platform and touch it for permanent lightning resistance. Mark its checkpoint first if you want to return after the boss.

shortcut.cue: Finish in Deshar before you portal
shortcut.detail: If you want the lightning resistance reward, visit the Sisters of Garukhan before leaving. After Tor Gul, portal to the caravan and speak to Asala to open the Dreadnought route.

optional.hint: Visit the Sisters of Garukhan for lightning resistance

reward.name: Lightning resistance
reward.direction: Find the Sisters of Garukhan shrine on a side platform in the Spires of Deshar and interact with it.

name: Mawdun Quarry
objective: Find the entrance to Mawdun Mine

route.cue: Cross the bridges to the mine

steps.detail: Use bridges to cross between open quarry sections. If a bridge dead-ends, stay on the edge until you find the next crossing.
The Mine entrance comes after another bridge. Check the Faridun War Cache near a checkpoint if you are looking for the optional loot.

optional.hint: Recover the Tinker’s Tools

name: Mawdun Mine
objective: Defeat Rudja and free Risu

route.cue: Follow the mine rails toward Rudja

steps.detail: Use the rails to orient as you cross the mine toward its far end.
After defeating Rudja, look for Risu and speak to her before returning to the caravan.

shortcut.cue: Portal after freeing and speaking to Risu
shortcut.detail: Free Risu after Rudja and speak to her before leaving. Portal to the caravan, then speak to Risu and Asala to continue at the Halani Gates.

optional.hint: Investigate the runic vault

name: The Dreadnought's Wake
objective: Cross the Dreadnought to reach Jamanra

route.cue: Keep crossing the gangways

steps.detail: Take the gangways that carry you farther along the convoy. Rejoin the forward route when a side deck ends.
Continue through the linked platforms to the next area for the Jamanra fight.

name: Dreadnought
objective: Defeat Jamanra, the Abomination
tip: Bring lightning resistance for Jamanra. Visit the Sisters of Garukhan in the Spires of Deshar for a permanent boost.

name: Trial of the Sekhemas
tip: For a first run, aim for character level 26–30. Equip relics with Honour resistance when available.

optional.hint: Finish the Sekhemas trial for Ascendancy

reward.name: Sekhemas Ascendancy points
reward.direction: Take a qualifying Djinn Barya to the Trial of the Sekhemas and claim the points after the trial.

name: Sandswept Marsh
objective: Cross the marsh to the Ziggurat

route.cue: Cross the marsh to its far edge

steps.detail: Use the direction the path leaves the waypoint to cross the marsh. Search the far edge for the encampment entrance.
Check along the edge near the encampment for a checkpoint by the Orok camp. Defeat the guards and search the basket for a Lesser Jeweller's Orb.

optional.hint: Search the Orok camp for supplies

name: Ziggurat Encampment
objective: Work with Alva to open the route below

name: Jungle Ruins
objective: Find the route into the Infested Barrens

route.cue: Try the far wall for the Barrens

steps.detail: Follow one outer wall toward the far side. If you find Gwendolyn Albright, speak to her for a minimap clue to the Barrens.
Look for a clearing ringed by broken pillars to find Mighty Silverfist for passive points. The waypoint is another useful landmark near the Venom Crypts entrance.
Later, bring Zicoatl's Large Soul Core back to the stone mechanism here to open the Matlan Waterways.

optional.hint: Defeat Mighty Silverfist for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from Mighty Silverfist
reward.direction: Find the clearing surrounded by broken pillars in the Jungle Ruins.

optional.hint: Detour into the Venom Crypts

route.cue: Find the Serpent Priestess corpse

steps.detail: Check the crypt chambers for the corpse and collect its venom for Servi.
Once you have the venom, use the onward exit if it is nearer than backtracking. Turn the venom in on your next visit to the encampment.

optional.hint: Recover the corpse venom for Servi

reward.name: Venom Draught
reward.direction: Collect the venom from the Serpent Priestess corpse in the crypts and take it to Servi.

name: Infested Barrens
objective: Find the passage to the Chimeral Wetlands

route.cue: Follow the outer edge to the Wetlands

steps.detail: Activate the waypoint near Alva as a return point. Search the boundary for the Chimeral Wetlands entrance.
If you spot the camp under attack, clear the enemies and check its rewards before continuing.

optional.hint: Investigate the Scrying Pool and vault

name: The Matlan Waterways
objective: Cross the canals using the pressure pads

route.cue: Step on pads to lower the water

steps.detail: Walk over each pad along the main canal route to lower the water and open the next crossing.
Watch for the side exit to the Azak Bog as you cross. Take it to fight Ignagduk for the Spirit reward.

shortcut.detail: Once the quest updates, use a town portal to the Ziggurat Encampment and speak to Alva to continue.

optional.hint: Take the detour to the Azak Bog

name: Chimeral Wetlands
objective: Defeat the Chimera and find the Machinarium
tip: The Chimera uses several elements. Balance your elemental resistances before fighting it.

route.cue: Search the edges for the Chimera

steps.detail: Follow the boundary to find Xyclucian's arena and the entrance to Jiquani's Machinarium.
Look along the upper edge for the temple and activate its waypoint when you find it. Bring back the Chimera's Ultimatum when ready for the trial.

optional.hint: Take its Ultimatum to the Temple of Chaos

name: Jiquani's Machinarium
objective: Use small Soul Cores to reach the Sanctum

route.cue: Check side rooms for small cores

steps.detail: Look down either side of the first room for the Small Soul Core that opens the door beside Alva.
Search side rooms for more cores and follow the main corridor toward the sealed Sanctum door.
Check the side doors in the second section. Spend spare cores to enter Blackjaw's arena and claim the permanent fire resistance reward.

optional.hint: Defeat Blackjaw for fire resistance

reward.name: Fire resistance
reward.direction: Use Small Soul Cores to open Blackjaw’s side room in the second section of the Machinarium. Use the Flame Core after the fight.

name: Jiquani's Sanctum
objective: Power the generators and defeat Zicoatl

route.cue: Find a generator in each wing

steps.detail: Search each wing for a Medium Soul Core and a generator near the back. Power both, then return toward the central chamber and fight Zicoatl.
If you find the corruption altar, use it only on an item you are willing to corrupt.

shortcut.cue: Waypoint back with the Large Soul Core
shortcut.detail: After taking the Large Soul Core, use the waypoint to return to the Jungle Ruins and socket it at the Canal Mechanism.

optional.hint: Find the corruption altar

route.cue: Start with the upper-right paths

steps.detail: Start by searching here for Ignagduk. If the paths dead-end, sweep the surrounding walkways.
If you find the ritual totems, activate them for a temporary fire resistance boost before fighting in the bog.

optional.hint: Defeat Ignagduk for Spirit

reward.name: Spirit from Ignagduk
reward.direction: Take the side exit off the Matlan Waterways to the Azak Bog. Defeat Ignagduk and use the Gemrot Skull.

name: The Drowned City
objective: Cross the ruins to the Apex of Filth

route.cue: Cross the ambush into the far ruins

steps.detail: Cross the narrow passage between the two main sets of ruins, then search the far section for the Apex of Filth entrance.
Look along the outer edges of the ruins for the vault and call Oswald at the entrance. Recover the hammer inside to unlock the Reforging Bench.

shortcut.detail: Activate the waypoint on your first visit. After getting the Temple Door Idol in Apex of Filth, travel back here and use the nearby entrance to the encampment.

optional.hint: Find the Molten Vault for Oswald

route.cue: Follow the vault to the molten channel

steps.detail: Find the checkpoint at the approach to the channel. Follow Mektul away from the advancing lava during the fight and recover the Hammer of Kamasa.
Use Frost Cores on the vault's gold chests if you want the extra loot.

shortcut.cue: Checkpoint back to the vault entrance
shortcut.detail: After taking the Hammer of Kamasa from Mektul, use checkpoint travel to the vault entrance. Return to the Drowned City and continue toward Apex of Filth.

optional.hint: Defeat Mektul and recover the forge treasure

name: The Temple of Chaos
tip: For the campaign Trial of Chaos, aim for character level 42–45 and high fire and lightning resistance.

optional.hint: Bring an Ultimatum to the Trial of Chaos

name: The Trial of Chaos
tip: For the campaign trial, aim for character level 42–45 and high fire and lightning resistance.

optional.hint: Complete the Trial of Chaos for Ascendancy

reward.name: Trial of Chaos Ascendancy points
reward.direction: Use the Chimera’s Inscribed Ultimatum at the temple and claim the points at the end of the trial.

name: Apex of Filth
objective: Defeat the queen and take the temple idol

route.cue: Pass the lore platform and arch

steps.detail: Cross the central platform past the lore marker and go under the arch. Continue from the checkpoint across the short bridge to the main ruins.
Search the far boundary of the ruins for the Queen's arena.
Bring one mushroom of each colour to the cauldron to receive a flask.

shortcut.cue: Return via the Drowned City waypoint
shortcut.detail: After collecting the Temple Door Idol, use the checkpoint to get back to the waypoint. Travel to the Drowned City and leave through its town entrance to reach Alva quickly.

optional.hint: Bring three mushrooms to the Cauldron Keeper

name: Temple of Kopec
bosses: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
objective: Defeat Ketzuli and follow Alva through the gateway

route.cue: Check the corners for stairs

steps.detail: Check the distant corner of each floor first. If there's no staircase, check the other corners.
If a break in the floor splits the area, start by looking beyond the crossing for the stairs to Ketzuli.

name: Utzaal
objective: Defeat Viper Napuatzi and reach Aggorat

route.cue: Past Viper, look for the stairs

steps.detail: After the fight, follow one side of the arena exit toward Aggorat. If it dead-ends, come back to the arena and take the other side toward the checkpoint and stairs.
Clear packs with Vaal Goliaths if you want a Sacrificial Heart to use at the altar in Aggorat.

optional.hint: Find the Sacrificial Heart
Explore the library for its Vaal lore

name: Aggorat
objective: Find the entrance to the Black Chambers

route.cue: Cross the chanting platform

steps.detail: Follow the voices to the worship platform and cross it. Pass through the arch to a checkpoint, then take the open branch toward the long stairs to the Black Chambers.
Look for the altar and the Sacrificial Dagger. Use them with the Sacrificial Heart to claim the passive points.

optional.hint: Offer the Sacrificial Heart for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from the Sacrificial Heart
reward.direction: Bring the heart from a Vaal Goliath pack to Aggorat. Find the Sacrificial Altar and use the dagger there.

name: The Black Chambers
objective: Defeat Doryani and advance the story
tip: Prioritize fire and lightning resistance for Doryani. Move away from the back of the machine when its lasers fire.

route.cue: Cross the bridges to Doryani

steps.detail: Follow the rooms to the first bridge, then continue toward the checkpoint at the next major crossing.
Stay near the centre of the route through the forming bridges until you reach the checkpoint at Doryani's arena.

name: Kingsmarch
objective: Arrange passage with Makoru and investigate the islands

route.cue: Meet Makoru aboard the ship

steps.detail: Head down to the docks and board the ship to choose an island. Use your quests to decide where to sail for the weapon fragments and Matiki. Their locations can vary by league.
Collect four Torn Map Pieces from the islands and turn them in at Kingsmarch to open the voyage to Plunder's Point.

name: Isle of Kin
objective: Find the way into the Volcanic Warrens

route.cue: Cross from the dock to the far wall

steps.detail: Head inland from the dock. When you reach the far boundary, follow it to find the Volcanic Warrens.
Search the wreckage and the Flayed Sailor near the shore for the Torn Map Piece.
If you come across the arena, defeat the Blind Beast for a Greater Blank Rune.

optional.hint: Defeat the Blind Beast
Recover a torn map piece

name: Volcanic Warrens
objective: Defeat Krutog and check the throne room

route.cue: Cross to the far side for Krutog

steps.detail: Work through the tunnels toward the opposite side of the zone for Krutog's throne. Collect the quest item or free Matiki if your league places either here.
If you find the side room with the Magma Twins, defeat both for a rare resistance ring.

shortcut.cue: Return to the ship after Krutog
shortcut.detail: After collecting the quest item or checking for Matiki, take the return route to the ship. Ask Makoru to sail to your next island if you have no town turn-ins.

name: Kedge Bay
objective: Continue along the coast to Journey’s End

route.cue: Follow the coast to Journey's End

steps.detail: Keep following the main shoreline path through the bay to the Journey's End entrance.
Check the side paths marked by checkpoints for the stash with the Torn Map Piece.

optional.hint: Recover a torn map piece

name: Journey's End
objective: Defeat Captain Hartlin and recover Verisium

route.cue: Find the wreck with the captain's chair

steps.detail: Follow the coastline toward the far side. Look for the stranded ship with a large chair on its upper deck and defeat Captain Hartlin for the ingots.
Have Dannig turn the ingots into spikes, then return to the totems near the entrance. Free Freya and finish the Omniphobia encounter for passive points.

optional.hint: Defeat Omniphobia for passive points

reward.name: Passive points from Dark Mists
reward.direction: Have Dannig turn Hartlin’s ingots into spikes, then free Freya at the ring of totems near the entrance. Finish the Omniphobia encounter.

name: Whakapanu Island
objective: Find the Singing Caverns

route.cue: Look for the Singing Caverns entrance

steps.detail: Use the shore and the outer edge to keep your bearings while looking for the entrance to the Singing Caverns.
Defeat the Great White One for the fin to bring to Kaimana. Look for the Petrified Pirate along the coast if you also want the Torn Map Piece.

optional.hint: Defeat the Great White One for its fin
Recover a torn map piece

name: Singing Caverns
objective: Confront Diamora

route.cue: Sweep the far half for Diamora

steps.detail: Work toward the far half of the cave. If one branch ends, take the other side of the loop toward Diamora's arena. Check the cage after the fight if Matiki is held here.
Look for the clam along the way and take the Humming Pearl for Rog.

shortcut.cue: Return to the ship after Diamora
shortcut.detail: After defeating Diamora, talk to the Hooded One and take the return route to the ship. You can save the Humming Pearl turn-in for your next planned town stop.

optional.hint: Recover the pearl from the clam

route.cue: Look for the fork after the third test

steps.detail: Meet Matiki at the well after freeing them. Follow the path through the three challenges, then take the branch toward the Halls of the Dead.
Take the other branch after the third challenge. Pay your respects and speak to Navali for the permanent maximum mana bonus.

optional.hint: Pass Hinekora’s trials
Visit the Silent Hall for maximum mana

reward.name: Maximum mana from the Silent Hall
reward.direction: Take the side branch after Hinekora’s third test. Pay your respects and speak to Navali in the Silent Hall.

route.cue: Follow the outer wall toward Yama

steps.detail: Sweep the outer paths for the three totems. Complete their tests for the tattoo choice.
Continue around the outer route beyond the totems. Defeat Yama to reach the Trial of the Ancestors.

optional.hint: Defeat Yama to reach the trial
Complete the three tattoo tests

reward.name: Hinekora tattoo bonus
reward.direction: Follow the outer paths in the Halls of the Dead to find the three totems. Complete the tests and choose a tattoo.

route.cue: Find Navali beyond Yama

steps.detail: Go through the entrance past Yama and speak to Navali and Hinekora to claim your passive points before leaving.

optional.hint: Speak with Navali for passive points

reward.name: Trial of the Ancestors passive points
reward.direction: After defeating Yama, enter the Trial of the Ancestors and speak to Navali and Hinekora.

name: Abandoned Prison
objective: Find the way into Solitary Confinement

route.cue: Use cell-block checkpoints to orient

steps.detail: Follow the main corridors and activate checkpoints as you go. If a block dead-ends, return to its last junction and try the next passage for Solitary Confinement.
Enemies can drop the Chapel Key. Use it on the chapel door, defeat Forael, and choose a permanent life or mana flask recovery bonus at the Goddess of Justice.

optional.hint: Choose a flask bonus at the chapel

reward.name: Permanent flask recovery bonus
reward.direction: Use the Chapel Key in Abandoned Prison, defeat Forael, and choose a bonus at the Goddess of Justice.

name: Solitary Confinement
objective: Defeat the Prisoner using the ballistae

route.cue: Follow the wall hit by waves

steps.detail: Follow the wall where the waves break to reach the Prisoner's arena.
Use the ballistae during the fight. Check the cage afterwards if Matiki is held on this island.

shortcut.cue: Return to the ship after the Prisoner
shortcut.detail: After the fight, speak to the Hooded One. Take the return route to the ship and talk to Makoru if you’re ready to sail to another island.

name: Shrike Island
objective: Defeat the Scourge of the Skies

route.cue: Follow the winding road to the end

steps.detail: Follow the winding path to the Scourge's arena. Check the cage after the fight if Matiki is held here.
Look for a checkpoint beside the nest and search the Impaled Karui for the Torn Map Piece.

optional.hint: Recover a torn map piece

name: Arastas
objective: Speak to Lorandis and investigate Arastas

name: Arastas
objective: Defeat Torvian and reach the Excavation

route.cue: Cross the coastal ridge past town

steps.detail: Leave the built-up section and cross the open ridge. Stay on the main path toward Torvian and the Excavation.
Check the edges of the ridge for the bell checkpoints. When you find the first bell, look across the ridge at roughly the same point for the second.

optional.hint: Find the two golden bells

name: The Excavation
objective: Defeat Benedictus and follow Tavakai

route.cue: Go past the connecting checkpoint

steps.detail: Leave the first set of rooms and pass the checkpoint at the chamber that links the two parts of the excavation.
Sweep the far edges of the second set of rooms for the entrance to Benedictus's arena.

name: Ngakanu
objective: Visit the settlement

route.cue: Start at the Ngakanu settlement

steps.detail: Find Kaimana while the settlement is still accessible and hand in the shark fin if you have it.

optional.hint: Bring the shark fin to Kaimana

reward.name: Tribal Medicine blessing
reward.direction: Take the Great White One’s fin to Kaimana. Look in the Ngakanu settlement, or check the Kingsmarch docks after Tavakai.

name: Ngakanu
objective: Find the Heart of the Tribe

route.cue: Go through the fence and follow the edge

steps.detail: Pass through the building near the landing and look for an opening in the fence.
Once through the fence, follow the boundary inland to reach the Heart of the Tribe.

optional.hint: Bring the shark fin to Kaimana

reward.name: Tribal Medicine blessing
reward.direction: Take the Great White One’s fin to Kaimana. Look in the Ngakanu settlement, or check the Kingsmarch docks after Tavakai.

name: Heart of the Tribe
objective: Defeat Tavakai and return to Kingsmarch
tip: Tavakai uses fire, cold, and lightning across his phases. Prepare all three elemental resistances.

route.cue: Head toward the far end for Tavakai

steps.detail: Work away from the landing toward the upper end of the map. If a branch stops at a checkpoint, try the passage across from it.
Continue through the inland paths to Tavakai. After the fight, return to Kingsmarch for the hand-ins.

route.cue: Find Dannig and the Deserted Post

steps.detail: Speak to Dannig and set the explosives. Include the entrance to the Deserted Post in the blast chain.
Enter the post and follow Farrow's quest prompts to unlock the Verisium Anvil.

optional.hint: Use the completed map to explore with Dannig
Complete the Runeseeker for the Verisium Anvil
